title: Investigating the mechanisms of resveratrol in the treatment of gouty arthritis through the integration of network pharmacology and metabolics.
authors: Xu, Xiaomin; Yu, Donghua; Wang, Yu; Jiang, Xin; Lu, Fang; Liu, Shumin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究白藜芦醇治疗痛风性关节炎的网络药理学与代谢组学机制，虽含分子对接但核心为炎症信号通路与代谢，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: This study integrates network pharmacology and metabolomics techniques to explore the potential regulatory mechanisms of Res on gouty arthritis (GA). METHODS: Network pharmacology was used to predict the mechanism of Res in regulating GA, and methods such as HE staining, ELISA, immunohistochemistry, Real-time PCR, Western blot, and molecular docking were used to verify the role of NF-kappaB, MAPK, and JAK/STAT inflammatory signaling pathways in the MSU-induced GA rat model. In addition, non-targeted metabolomics techniques were combined to further investigate the mechanism of Res in treating GA. RESULTS: The results of network pharmacology showed that Res may exert its therapeutic effects through the NF-kappaB signaling pathway. Animal experiments demonstrated that in the MSU-induced GA rat model, pathological damage, serum biochemical indicators, and levels of inflammatory factors were significantly increased, and the NF-kappaB signaling pathway was activated. The intervention of Res significantly reduced pathological damage, serum biochemical indicators, levels of inflammatory factors, and the activation of NF-kappaB, MAPK, and JAK/STAT signaling pathways in the model rats. Metabolomics results showed that Res could improve the metabolic trajectory deviations in serum and joint fluid of GA model rats. Through related metabolic pathway analysis, the most affected metabolic pathways were found to be Sphingolipid metabolism, Glycerophospholipid metabolism, Phenylalanine, tyrosine and tryptophan biosynthesis, Pantothenate and CoA, Citrate cycle (TCA cycle), and Arachidonic acid metabolism. CONCLUSION: Resveratrol can regulate the biosynthetic pathways of arachidonic acid, phenylalanine, tyrosine, and tryptophan, pantothenic acid and CoA biosynthesis pathways, TCA cycle, and other metabolic pathways, thereby regulating the NF-kappaB, MAPK, and JAK/STAT3 signaling pathways, and inhibiting the acute inflammatory response during GA attacks, showing characteristics of multi-pathway and multi-target action.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究整合网络药理学与代谢组学技术，探讨Res对痛风性关节炎（GA）的潜在调控机制。方法：采用网络药理学预测Res调控GA的机制，并通过HE染色、ELISA、免疫组织化学、Real-time PCR、Western blot及分子对接等方法，验证NF-kappaB、MAPK和JAK/STAT炎症信号通路在MSU诱导的GA大鼠模型中的作用。此外，结合非靶向代谢组学技术，进一步研究Res治疗GA的机制。结果：网络药理学结果显示，Res可能通过NF-kappaB信号通路发挥其治疗作用。动物实验表明，在MSU诱导的GA大鼠模型中，病理损伤、血清生化指标及炎症因子水平显著升高，且NF-kappaB信号通路被激活。Res干预显著降低了模型大鼠的病理损伤、血清生化指标、炎症因子水平及NF-kappaB、MAPK和JAK/STAT信号通路的激活。代谢组学结果显示，Res可改善GA模型大鼠血清和关节液中代谢轨迹的偏差。通过相关代谢通路分析，受影响最大的代谢通路为鞘脂代谢、甘油磷脂代谢、苯丙氨酸、酪氨酸和色氨酸生物合成、泛酸和CoA、柠檬酸循环（TCA循环）及花生四烯酸代谢。结论：白藜芦醇可调节花生四烯酸、苯丙氨酸、酪氨酸和色氨酸的生物合成通路、泛酸和CoA生物合成通路、TCA循环及其他代谢通路，从而调控NF-kappaB、MAPK和JAK/STAT3信号通路，抑制GA发作期间的急性炎症反应，显示出多通路、多靶点的作用特点。
